# Outgoing Transfers – Reversal SOP
Owner: Sara (Payments Ops). Last reviewed with Settlement team in Sept.

## 1. Scope
Covers outgoing transfers from wallet to other banks (all rails).

## 2. Common failure reasons
- beneficiary account closed / title mismatch
- bank side timeout (rare, mostly month-end)

## 3. Reversal timeline
When an outgoing transfer fails, the amount is reversed to the customer's wallet within 4 business days. Instant-rail transfers are reversed within 1 business day (see Instant Rail: Reversal Exception). How to tell the rail: check "Rail" on the transaction in the admin panel. Do NOT promise same day. If it's been longer than that, raise a Jira ticket to Settlement with the TxID.

## 4. Fees
Transfer fee is refunded with the principal. No separate request needed.
